_comment: PER-REGION BADLANDS + NEHEKHARA tile of the TWW3 Old World mod parchment, placed by the paired-anchor-dot workflow (the same one validated on the Empire, then Bretonnia, Kislev+Norsca and the Dark Lands, 2026-08-14/17). The whole-map fit of this source is impossible — it draws different regions at inconsistent scale, so no single warp reconciles it (see the landmark-accuracy wall). Instead the user cropped the southern Old World arc out (alpha-erasing everything outside it) and drew matched colour dots on the crop AND on terraqueous_globe_reprojected.png, which IS the canvas/mask frame (8192x3616). The dot centroids, recovered by exact RGB, give 18 source<->canvas correspondences used as landmarks (the interior south-central 'yellow' dot of the original 17 was held out on the user's A/B request, 2026-08-17; pink/sky were added in a second pass, 2026-09-02); a thin-plate through them places the tile exactly at every landmark. objective=landmarks means NO silhouette fit (the drift-prone stage), just the interpolation. master_shape is the crop's native (h,w) = (2567,3462); the source is the dot-free, alpha-masked crop. This record only PLACES the tile (like the Empire/Bretonnia/Kislev/Dark Lands tiles); no geometry is extracted yet.
_comment_lattice: 6x6 over the crop (~577 master px horizontal spacing, ~428 vertical). The 18 landmark dots span the region's coastal/edge extremes — teal at the far-west peninsula tip, purple/navy along the north edge, cyan/lavender far-east, rose on the west coast, mint/chartreuse/olive across the interior, plus pink/sky added in the second pass in the south-central interior to anchor the previously sparse band around the held-out yellow dot — so the thin-plate is anchored to the perimeter and the interior, not just the middle; the lattice regularises it and captures the affine trend out to the crop corners, where it extrapolates beyond the dot hull. Global-affine residual figures below are from the original 16-pair fit (mean 34 / max 89 px, the interior/southern points, where the source's inconsistent-scale projection curves most); the x/y affine scales differ (~0.427 vs ~0.358), which is exactly that inconsistent inter-region scale — non-affine curvature the thin-plate absorbs exactly at each dot. Holding out the interior south-central yellow dot removed the largest local interior pull and lowered the residual from 39/112 (17 pairs) to 34/89.
_comment_landmarks: source px = dot centroid in the crop's own 3462x2567 frame (x,y); canvas px = the SAME dot's centroid read straight off terraqueous_globe_reprojected.png (= canvas space, no globe-fit indirection). Paired by the colour the user drew (pure marker palette: every channel in {0,63,127,191,255}). All 19 marker colours (the original 17 plus the second-pass pink/sky) were present in both frames as a single 12-px component each, no strays; 18 are used here as landmarks. The interior south-central 'yellow' dot (crop [2126.5,1888.5] / canvas [4264.5,1613.5]) is HELD OUT per the user's A/B compare (2026-08-17) — it is still a marker in the crop image and gets inpainted out with the rest when the clean source is derived; it simply takes no part in the fit. pink and sky were added in a second pass (2026-09-02) to densify the previously dot-sparse interior band around the held-out yellow dot. These 18 ARE the fit (not a held-out check) for objective=landmarks.

record.notes: PROVISIONAL. Badlands + Nehekhara crop of the TWW3 Old World mod parchment ('The Old World, all faction starting positions v3.0'), registered against tools/derived/land_sea_mask.png by tools/fit_registration.py --seed tww3_old_world_mod_parchment_badlands_nehekhara (objective=landmarks; 16 user-drawn paired anchor dots read direct off terraqueous_globe_reprojected.png, of 17 marked — interior south-central 'yellow' held out per the user's A/B compare; 6x6 lattice). A DENSE Old World boundary network confined to the southern Old World arc (Badlands, Border Princes, the Dead Sea coast toward Nehekhara) — the whole-source fit is defeated by its inconsistent inter-region scale, so this per-region carve is the way in. Contributes NO coastline (the mask remains the sole authority, user decision #1) and no geometry yet: this request only PLACES it. precedence/layer_precedence are provisional placement values, to be revisited when boundary extraction lands (S6). PROVISIONAL until the user accepts the diagnostic render. MACHINE-FITTED; re-derive from the seed, do not hand-edit.
